notes.title: Intro to Robot Rhapsody
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640484/0176111678d1edcab9bb4fa9dcb4756ce529412c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Hello everyone. Aaron / Lead Dev here. [/b]    [/h3][h3]I’m quite happy to finally share the first blog update for [i]Robot Rhapsody[/i], which we've been cooking for about half a year now!

If you played [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017620/Beloved_Rapture/"]Beloved Rapture[/url], our first title, you may notice some familiar DNA in the presentation style — but I wanted to note this is a completely original, stand-alone story.[/h3][h3][i]It’s a script I believe could even surpass the work we did in the past, so it’s been a joy to develop so far. :D[/i][/h3][p][/p][p]I'd like to share some additional info and imagery people may not have seen yet.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640484/a4bb33f8b914cc366f72713dcad4b7a12592287a.png"][/img][/h3][h1]👉🔥[u][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rapturousstudio/robot-rhapsody"]Follow the Kickstarter[/url]![/u][/h1][p][/p][h2]🎮✨ [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Rapturous%20Studio"]Rapturous Studio[/url][/u] - Join [u][url="https://discord.com/invite/Y4rKwzQk7T"]Discord Server[/url]![/u][/h2][p][/p][h3]The story unfolds as a "futurist fairytale", filtered through classic 90s JRPG style. [/h3][h3]Themes related to Artificial Intelligence, VR/simulations, freedom & authenticity, humanity’s return to nature, and 'rebellion' are all focused on.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640484/6b7deb9683ca590c913857df8a46316d69ef5001.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640484/4193e26ea9251fe5473d7efc8ac91fbddeabff67.png"][/img][/p][h2][b][u]Story Notes[/u][/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640484/412e2c05e0a215f8620c6efb087df8d060221811.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640484/8bec3c699bc020c89a7578dd88f209548f1722c3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]The player follows [u]Selva[/u][/b], a crude, sarcastic mercenary who once hunted “rogue”  machines for a living.[/h3][h3]Now she lives off-the-grid in [b]Zoxxo City[/b], a former metropolis decayed into an anarchic urban jungle. [/h3][h3]Selva indulges a life of simpler pleasures, though no matter where she runs, she can't find a way to fit in.[/h3][h3][i]But some new political upheaval—and the death of her former boss—force her back into the spiritual battle that she thought she’d left behind.[/i][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640484/09749142445c635fb3f6d2bfcce60ae59fec5648.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640484/be5acee267095eeff29c5d9240b1a2b722d16e17.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Her closest ally is [b][u]Jiro[/u][/b], a boy raised inside the [b]Aethar Hives[/b]—underground nuclear bunkers transformed into AI-run “utopias.” [/h3][h3]Life inside the Hives means a [b]Neura-Stone[/b] implanted at birth, binding each human to rigid AI control and oversight. [/h3][h3]Robots feed, teach, and guide their human subjects. Freedom and emotion are surrendered in exchange for supposed safety. [/h3][h3]Eventually, his first "organic dream" prompts a spiral of disillusionment.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640484/4208dc38e24c4355ce37866288f063c8f18f692d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Eventually, Selva shows Jiro the chaos and beauty of real life, no matter how cruel it may be.[/h3][h3]Jiro, meanwhile, forces her to confront her deep and irrational hatred of technology.  [/h3][h3]Their unexpected bond eventually spawns a mass rebellion.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640484/9ad05fa4f082d5ebee771f6b97d9a66f454880f3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🌌 Inspired by[b] futurism[/b], [b]retro-sci-fi[/b], 90s JRPGs, and [b]cyberpunk/solarpunk art.[/b][/h3][h3]✨ Pixel Art drawn in the style of [b]SNES / PlayStation 1 era.[/b][/h3][h3]🎮 Turn-Based-Battles, similar to the classics.[/h3][h3]🛠️ [b]Robots are a central theme of both story + gameplay.[/b]  The party can inflict machine-specific status effects:[/h3][list][*][p]⚡ [b]Short-Circuit[/b] → Paralyze/Stun the enemy[/p][/*][*][p]🦠 [b]VIRUS[/b] → Elicit Confused / Berserk behaviors[/p][/*][*][p]💻 [b]HACK[/b] → Reprogram certain robotic enemies (non-bosses) to fight alongside the party![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640484/1ff2c263697acdad875696ddb59f16e399dcf8d3.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Find [b]Gears[/b] and other machine parts in order to upgrade your acquired bots[b].[/b][/h3][h3]Once you bring any machines to your side - they're yours forever -  unless destroyed in combat.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640484/41913df0fb37d3569e2a8c948ec7e4b0a83eb1ab.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640484/cfe0be1342d50e183add38f0af9f557912fc4204.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]Main Dev Team[/h1][h3]I’m grateful to be working again with some of the same collaborators as last time around.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]🎨 [url="https://www.deviantart.com/trick17/gallery/all"]Fabian[/url], the artist who drew the painterly environments and sprites for Beloved Rapture, will return to help me envision this story's more apocalyptic[i] [/i]world. Solar-punk jungle cities, labyrinthine bunkers, robot junkyards, toxic wastes, and surreal VR will be among the many locations.[/h3][p][/p][h3]🎵 [url="https://ocremix.org/artist/4625/snappleman"]Andreas[/url], who composed 95% of BR's soundtrack, is also returning. [/h3][h3]Specifically in [i]Robot Rhapsody, [/i]we will lean into the classic 90s synths and Playstation 1 soundfonts.  I have no doubt that his unique touch will provoke a mix of wonder, nostalgia, atmosphere, and melancholy. [/h3][p][/p][h3]Aaron / '[url="https://bsky.app/profile/rapturousgames.bsky.social"]Blind[/url]' - That's me! I'll be writing/directing and creating the level designs for Robot Rhapsody, just as I did with BR.[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="IxXsswrrGg8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]🔥Upcoming! 🔥[/h1][p][/p][h1]👉[url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rapturousstudio/robot-rhapsody" buttoncolor="#37fb5e"]Follow the Kickstarter[/url] - Launching Nov 2025![/h1][p][/p][h3]We’ll be running a [b]crowdfunding campaign in November[/b] to help bring this project further to life. :D[/h3][h3]The Kickstarter will set the stage for expanded art, music, and eventually console porting.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640484/b3760ca1898c4a4c8597875e4489f6a4b1cd4a3f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][i]For now, if you want to support this game, [b]you can help us spread the word about the campaign[/b], Wishlist Robot Rhapsody on Steam, and stay tuned for more dev logs, music, and videos in the coming weeks.[/i] [/h3][p][/p][h3]Your support truly means so much to me, at this early stage of production.
So I thank you all - whoever's reading this!

Cheers,[/h3][p][/p][h3]—Aaron
Rapturous Studio[/h3]
